verdict.rationale: Pylon's Assist Agent is documented as an interactive AI teammate that drafts replies for the team. That implies a human-in-the-loop drafting workflow, but the docs never describe a supervised launch mode or an approval gate on the customer-facing Support Agent. Issue assignment controls which issues the agent touches, and simulation is a pre-deployment dry run rather than supervised live operation. Missing for 10: a documented supervised/draft-only mode for the Support Agent, an explicit approval queue or gate before messages reach customers, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a support ops lead, I can launch in a supervised mode where the agent drafts replies for human approval before anything reaches a customer

citations.quote: Assist Agent is an interactive AI teammate that helps your team investigate questions, draft replies, and take action with the context already available in Pylon.
